scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of exact envelopes, pointwise area formula, derivative sign and endpoint cases; computational identities and rational geometry tests are corroborative, not substitutes for proof. No historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Central Euclidean two-plane sections of the three-dimensional unit cross-polytope only; the diameter formula is known, and the new assertion is the complete conditional area range and equality classification. No random joint law, arbitrary polytope theorem or higher-dimensional extension is claimed. The historical novelty comparison is limited by inaccessible full text of two relevant preprints. Independent validation remains outstanding.
title: Sharp area–diameter spectrum of central sections of the regular octahedron
